headline: Are My Windows Letting Money Fly Out?
articleBody:
It's easy to overlook your windows until you start feeling a draft or see a jump in your utility bills. Old or inefficient windows can be big energy drains, basically like leaving a window open even when it's closed! This is especially true in a place like Southern California, where temperature swings mean your HVAC system works overtime to keep your home comfortable. Common culprits are single-pane windows, frames that have warped or deteriorated over time, or seals that have failed. 

Beyond energy loss, you might notice condensation between panes, indicating a broken seal, or increased noise from outside. These are all signs your windows aren't performing their best. Upgrading to modern, energy-efficient windows, like those we install in Cerritos and Glendale, can significantly reduce heat transfer, lower your energy costs, and make your home much more comfortable year-round. Don't let those old windows keep costing you; a quick assessment by a professional can pinpoint exactly where you're losing money and comfort.
